description: Judgment question (a) test quality (spec judgment#questions): is a test tautological, implementation-coupled or ok? The labelled set (question.json, cases.json, hidden reference/expectations.json; director-owned, never tuned) benched on every classifier Pi lists as available: per model accuracy, calibration (Brier, ECE, confidence buckets) and cost, train and held-out apart, one model chosen and a gating threshold proposed from train only. Every answer is a model judgment: advisory, no gate reads it.
